crossRefs.note: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” He answered, “It is.”

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: Asahel
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, killed by Abner

translations.web: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” He answered, “It is.”
translations.bsb: And Abner glanced back and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” “It is,” Asahel replied.
translations.kjv: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am.
translations.asv: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Is it thou, Asahel? And he answered, It is I.
